summary: Iteration 52 — Verified bulk-delete across all 8 surfaces (customers, users, documents, uploads, transactions, notes, follow-ups, templates). Backend: 48/48 pytest cases pass (validation 400s, role gating 403s, non-existent-id -> deleted_count:0, cascade delete, self-lockout on users bulk-delete, totals recompute on transactions bulk-delete, uploaded_documents pointer-map strip, latest_call_status recompute on follow-ups bulk-delete). Frontend: BulkDeleteBar renders correctly on /customers (bar hidden at 0, appears at count>=1 with red style, dialog opens with preview list, Cancel/Clear work). Ramya detail tabs expose bulk-select checkboxes on Notes (2), Follow-ups (5), Uploads (3), Transactions (4), Documents (40+). Settings > User Management shows disabled self checkbox for the current admin.

minor.issue: Single-delete does NOT cascade to payment_transactions, but POST /api/customers/bulk-delete DOES. Problem statement asserts 'parity with the single-delete' but the parity is actually broken by the single-delete path leaving orphan payment_transactions behind. Bulk-delete is strictly more thorough. Recommend adding db.payment_transactions.delete_many() to /app/backend/customers/routes.py:delete_customer (line 270).

action_items: Optional parity fix: add `await db.payment_transactions.delete_many({"customer_id": customer_id})` to DELETE /api/customers/{id} single-delete handler (customers/routes.py line ~283) — bulk-delete already does this but single-delete leaves orphan txns.
critical_code_review_comments: useBulkSelect hook is clean and reusable: exposes selectedIds/toggle/toggleAll/isAllSelected/isPartiallySelected/clear as promised. Set-based state is O(1) toggle. Header checkbox toggle correctly handles the mixed-selection case.

BulkDeleteBar returns null on selectedCount===0 (matches spec 'renders nothing when count=0'). Preview shows first 20 with a '…and N more' suffix. All 7 required test-ids per instance are wired (root, count, clear, trigger, dialog, preview, cancel, confirm). AlertDialog blocks close during delete (setDeleting guard on onOpenChange).

All 8 backend bulk-delete endpoints use check_role([UserRole.ADMIN]) as required. Validation is uniformly {ids:[]}->400, missing ids->400, non-array ids->400 (via `body.get('ids') or []` + isinstance check).
Users bulk-delete strips current_user.id server-side (line 215) — verified via test: admin passes [own_id, other_id] gets deleted_count=1 and /me still works.
Transactions bulk-delete correctly recomputes customer.total_received/balance_amount/percentages after delete_many.
Uploaded documents bulk-delete strips entries from customer.uploaded_documents pointer map (line 796-802).
Follow-ups bulk-delete calls _recompute_latest_call_status after $pull — verified: latest_call_status flips back after bulk-delete removes the newest entries.
Notes bulk-delete uses $pull with $in — atomic, no race condition.

Customers bulk-delete cascades to 5 collections (payment_schedules, document_checklists, generated_documents, communication_logs, payment_transactions). Note: this is MORE than single-delete cascades (single-delete misses payment_transactions) — flagged as minor above.
Templates bulk-delete removes overrides so defaults are restored — behavior matches single-delete /api/templates/{id}.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — CustomersPage bulk-delete E2E (checkbox column, bar visibility, count, clear, dialog, preview, cancel) all pass; customer-detail tabs (Notes/Follow-ups/Uploads/Transactions/Documents) expose bulk-select checkboxes with correct test-id prefixes; Settings > User Management disables the current admin's own row.

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_-prefixed throwaway customers (5 customers, 2 uploaded docs, 2 transactions, 2 generated docs, 2 notes on Ramya, 2 follow-ups on Ramya, 1 throwaway user) — all cleaned up by the bulk-delete path under test. No real data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 52 verified all 8 bulk-delete surfaces end-to-end. Regression-safe test file: /app/backend/tests/test_bulk_delete_iteration52.py — 48 tests, all green, safe to re-run. Only minor finding: DELETE /api/customers/{id} single-delete doesn't cascade to payment_transactions while bulk-delete does — a pre-existing inconsistency, not caused by this iteration. The frontend Documents tab per-row checkbox uses testid prefix 'bulk-select-doc-' (not 'bulk-select-document-'); this differs from other tabs (bulk-select-note-, bulk-select-upload-, bulk-select-transaction-, bulk-select-follow-up-, bulk-select-user-, bulk-select-customer-) but the bulk-delete bar test-ids follow the standard bulk-delete-{surface} convention correctly.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature completed correctly. All contract points (role gating, empty-ids 400, non-existent-ids returning deleted_count:0 without 500, self-lockout on users, cascade on customers, totals recompute on transactions, pointer-map strip on uploads, latest_call_status recompute on follow-ups) verified by 48 pytest cases + 3 Playwright flows.
